verses.restored: In those days, when again there was a great crowd and they had nothing to eat, he called the disciples and said to them,

familiar.text: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,

verses.restored: I am moved with compassion for the crowd, because they remain with me three days and have nothing to eat.

familiar.text: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

verses.restored: If I release them hungry to their houses, they will faint on the way; and some of them have come from far away.

familiar.text: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.

verses.restored: His disciples answered, From where will anyone be able to feed these people with bread here in a deserted place?

familiar.text: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?

verses.restored: He asked them, How many loaves do you have? They said, Seven.

familiar.text: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

verses.restored: He instructed the crowd to recline on the ground; taking the seven loaves, giving thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and they set them before the crowd.

familiar.text: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.

verses.restored: They also had a few little fish; blessing them, he said to set these before them also.

familiar.text: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.

verses.restored: They ate and were filled, and they took up seven baskets of broken pieces remaining.

familiar.text: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.

verses.restored: There were about four thousand. He released them.

familiar.text: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

verses.restored: Immediately, entering the boat with his disciples, he came into the region of Dalmanutha.

familiar.text: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

verses.restored: The Pharisees came out and began to argue with him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, testing him.

familiar.text: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.

verses.restored: Sighing deeply in his spirit, he said, Why does this generation seek a sign? Amen, I say to you: no sign will be given to this generation.

familiar.text: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.

verses.restored: Leaving them, he again entered the boat and went away to the other side.

familiar.text: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.

verses.restored: They forgot to take bread, and except for one loaf they had none with them in the boat.

familiar.text: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

verses.restored: He instructed them, saying, Watch; beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod.

familiar.text: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.

verses.restored: They were reasoning with one another because they had no bread.

familiar.text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.

verses.restored: Knowing this, he said to them, Why are you reasoning because you have no bread? Do you not yet perceive or understand? Have your hearts been hardened?

familiar.text: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

verses.restored: Having eyes, do you not see? Having ears, do you not hear? And do you not remember?

familiar.text: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

verses.restored: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up? They said to him, Twelve.

familiar.text: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.

verses.restored: And the seven for the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up? They said, Seven.

familiar.text: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.

verses.restored: He said to them, Do you not yet understand?

familiar.text: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?

verses.restored: They came to Bethsaida. They brought to him a blind man and pleaded with him to touch him.

familiar.text: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.

verses.restored: Taking the blind man by the hand, he brought him outside the village; spitting on his eyes and placing hands on him, he asked, Do you see anything?

familiar.text: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.

verses.restored: Looking up, he said, I see people, because I see them like trees walking around.

familiar.text: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

verses.restored: Then again he placed hands on his eyes, and he looked intently and was restored, and he saw everything clearly.

familiar.text: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

verses.restored: He sent him away to his house, saying, Do not even enter the village.

familiar.text: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.

verses.restored: Jesus and his disciples went out to the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he questioned his disciples, saying, Who do people say I am?

familiar.text: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

verses.restored: They said to him, John the Baptist; others, Elijah; others, one of the prophets.

familiar.text: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.

verses.restored: He questioned them, But you, who do you say I am? Peter answered him, You are the Messiah.

familiar.text: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.

verses.restored: He strictly warned them that they should tell no one about him.

familiar.text: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.

verses.restored: He began to teach them that it is necessary for the Son of Humanity to suffer many things, be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, be killed, and after three days rise.

familiar.text: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

verses.restored: He was speaking the word plainly. Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.

familiar.text: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

verses.restored: Turning and seeing his disciples, he rebuked Peter and said, Go behind me, adversary, because you are not thinking the things of the Divine but the things of humans.

familiar.text: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.

verses.restored: Calling the crowd with his disciples, he said to them, If anyone wants to come after me, let that one deny self, take up the cross, and follow me.

familiar.text: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

verses.restored: For whoever wants to save his life/soul will lose it, but whoever loses his life/soul because of me and the good message will save it.

familiar.text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s, the same shall save it.

verses.restored: For what does it profit a person to gain the whole world and forfeit one's life/soul?

familiar.text: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

verses.restored: For what can a person give in exchange for one's life/soul?

familiar.text: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

verses.restored: Whoever is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and misaligned generation, of that one the Son of Humanity will also be ashamed when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy messengers.

familiar.text: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
